answer: Because the dune ordering is published with the pigment batch, the zenith audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 25% of the queue is processed in arrival order. A farm that floods the queue early therefore gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 422 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
